messages:
marco (hiring mgr): hey team — we have 5 contract engineers starting next Monday. want to bulk-create onboarding pages from the canonical "Contractor Onboard" template and prefill manager, start date, and role. is there a clean CSV -> Notion flow or should i create them manually?

kai (DevEx): welcome to the chaos :sweat_smile: Notion supports CSV import to create pages, but the canonical onboarding template uses template variables and relations (Actions DB, Tasks). CSV import gives you flat pages without relations.

marco (hiring mgr): ah ok. is there a way to import CSV and then run a script to attach relations and set properties?

mira (Docs Owner): short answer: yes, but it requires two steps. 1) duplicate the template to a team folder and make a single-page canonical copy with the fields exposed as top-level properties (Owner, ManagerEmail, StartDate, Role, TemplateID). 2) use the Notion API or our internal automation to create pages from structured data and wire relations. We typically recommend the internal automation bc it preserves linked DB relations.

claudia (onboarding coordinator): we ran this for interns last quarter. workflow we used: Google Sheet -> internal CSV cleaner -> infra automation job -> creates pages under /Company Home/Onboarding/Batch-Creates/<batch-name> and assigns Owner+permissions.

marco (hiring mgr): can you paste the sample CSV format?

claudia (onboarding coordinator): sure. sample rows we used: 

```
FullName,Email,ManagerEmail,StartDate,Role,Team,TemplateID
Ana Gomez,ana@contractor.com,marco@redwood.com,2026-04-06,Contractor,eng-platform,contractor-v1
Ben Li,ben@contractor.com,marco@redwood.com,2026-04-06,Contractor,eng-platform,contractor-v1
```

mira (Docs Owner): after import the automation sets page properties and creates a relation to the Actions DB and Tasks DB. It also sets permissions: manager gets Can edit, team group gets Can view.

marco (hiring mgr): great. who runs the infra automation job? do i file a ticket?

infra-bot: For automation requests, create an infra-automation ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra-automation. Include CSV (or Google Sheet link), Notion TemplateID, target folder path, and desired permissions. SLA: 2 business days for scheduling.

marco (hiring mgr): thanks. any security concerns about putting contractor emails in Notion pages?

mira (Docs Owner): good call. contractors should be given minimal access: the page owner (redwood user) is the manager, and contractor accounts are invited as Guest users only if absolutely needed. We prefer using a Manager-facing checklist first and then inviting contractors to their pages after HR completes background checks. Also set Confidentiality: contractor tag on the page.

kai (DevEx): another gotcha: template variables ({{ManagerEmail}}) are only substituted by our internal duplication flow. If you import via CSV directly, you need the automation to perform substitutions. Otherwise fill them manually.

marco (hiring mgr): ok i'll prepare the CSV and file the infra ticket. one last question: can the created pages automatically add an event to the onboard calendar and schedule a 1:1 with me?

infra-bot: Yes. Include "calendar_sync: true" and "schedule_1:1: manager=marco@redwood.com,time=30" in the ticket payload. Enabling calendar/webhook sync requires infra approval for the calendar integration.

claudia (onboarding coordinator): when we did this we also asked Docs to run a quick quality check after pages are created. @mira — can docs review the batch once infra finishes?

mira (Docs Owner): absolutely. please tag @docs-review in the ticket comments or DM me the batch folder link and i'll run the checklist: properties, links, code blocks, relations, and visibility.

marco (hiring mgr): awesome — i'll attach the sheet and open infra ticket now. thanks everyone! :rocket:

people-ops-bot: Reminder: contractor onboarding must include HR packet and NDAs. Add HRIS-ID and BackgroundCheckStatus columns to your CSV. For access provisioning, follow the Contractor Access playbook in /Company Home/Onboarding/Contractors.
